column1: # W46 detector-parity power check: alpha sweep for the hybrid (baseline + same
# WHY. The already-measured parity cells use GEOPACT_PUB_HYBRID_ALPHA=2.0, which
# builds mass m_j = 1 + alpha * P_j with P max-normalised to [0,1]
# (geopact_vl_hook.py:2383). TRACE's own BAM mass is m_j = 1 + alpha * n * p_j
# with p a probability measure (geopact_qd_selector.py:1006), so at equal alpha
# the baselines receive a prior whose dynamic range is ~n times weaker. That
# makes the control under-powered. This sweep raises alpha so the
# parity arms are reported at their OWN best setting, i.e. the reading least
# alpha = 2 cells already exist under logs/xds8b_abl2/screenspot_v2/hyb_*.
